title: From the big picture to the next task.
description: See what’s moving, find what needs attention, and keep everyone working from the same view of the project.

previews.label: Overview
previews.title: Know where the work stands.
previews.description: Project totals, completed tasks and recent activity bring the workspace into focus.
previews.alt: Workspace overview with project metrics, task completion chart and recent activity.

previews.label: Board
previews.title: Keep work moving.
previews.description: Move projects from In progress to In review to Completed. Filters and ownership stay connected across views.
previews.alt: Project board with In progress, In review and Completed columns.

previews.label: Details
previews.title: Get the context. Take the next step.
previews.description: Find the owner, due date, progress and project activity together, with editing one step away.
previews.alt: Brand refresh project details with owner, due date, task progress and activity.

features.title: One project, three views
features.description: Use a table for detail, cards for scanning, or the board for status. Your projects stay in sync.

features.title: Clear ownership
features.description: Assign a person, set a due date and review progress without piecing together separate screens.

features.title: Make it feel like yours
features.description: Choose a theme, accent, typeface and density. The same preferences reach every page and panel.

questions.question: Can I try these workflows?
questions.answer: Yes. Every preview links directly to the matching demo page. You can create and edit projects, move cards and change settings without signing up.

questions.question: What happens when I complete a project?
questions.answer: Completing a project finishes its remaining tasks and records the change in activity. Reopening the project preserves those completed tasks.

questions.question: Are my changes saved?
questions.answer: Demo changes and drafts stay in memory while you navigate. Reload or Reset demo restores the sample data. Appearance preferences are saved on this device.
